Upstream package: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS (noble) shim-signed 1.58+15.8-0ubuntu1

Package SHA-256: BA9B5D80E5D886C30664F2BEBFB5C2FCCE3B9B40F16FC46CBA49C19A91C8059C
Package member: /usr/lib/shim/shimx64.efi.signed.latest
Asset SHA-256: 6FE6E1BCBE6CF6BAEC8E056D40361CA1AA715CC04DDCC2855351DE060B84350B
Signer subject: Microsoft Windows UEFI Driver Publisher
Signer issuer: Microsoft Corporation UEFI CA 2011
Signature timestamp: 2024-02-27T18:07:54Z

The PE contains a Microsoft UEFI signature. On the development host,
signtool /kp identified the signer chain but could not build it to a locally
trusted Microsoft Third Party Marketplace Root (0x800B010A). The package and
asset hashes above are therefore pinned independently. Secure Boot acceptance
must still be verified in the snapshot-protected target VM before release.

The upstream shim build defaults to grubx64.efi as its x64 second-stage name:
https://github.com/rhboot/shim/blob/main/BUILDING
